title: SPEC: deprecate daemon global workspace pointer
summary: Goal: remove the daemon-global default workspace pointer (state.workspace / state.overlay single-slot cache + WS_FILE persistence + boot pin) so every graph op carries an explicit workspace and a missing one fails loudly (400) instead of silently landing in the wrong graph. The modern MCP client (lib/mcp-core makeCall) ALREADY injects workspace into every POST body and every GET as ?workspace= — so the global is dead weight on the hot path, consulted only as a silent fallback. FOUR couplings must be cut, in order: (1) in-memory overlay cache — state.overlay is the single loaded overlay for state.workspace; targetOverlay returns it directly when ws===state.workspace (daemon.js ~427-432). Replace with a per-workspace Map<ws,overlay> cache. (2) sweeps + loops default ws=state.workspace (daemon.js sweepStaleClaims/sweepFailedTasks/sweepStaleVerdicts/sweepStaleGuidance ~608/634/677/724 and the loop tick ~789); the loop tick already builds activeWsSet from active loops UNION state.workspace (~1173-1186) — drop the union term and iterate workspaces.json. (3) dashboard default view — routes/graph.js (7 refs) + public/graph.html resolve 'current workspace' when no ?workspace= given; must always carry an explicit workspace. (4) respawn restore + boot pin — WS_FILE read at loadState ~336-346, boot POST /workspace at mcp-graph.js:81, persistence at setWorkspace ~2057. state.workspace=51 refs in daemon.js + routes/{graph,overlay,meta,task,judge,analytics,exec,classify,label}.js. Phasing: P1 observe (warn on every fallback, zero behavior change, surfaces remaining implicit callers) -> P2a per-workspace overlay cache -> P2b sweeps/loops/routes enumerate workspaces.json + dashboard requires explicit ws -> P3 delete state.workspace/state.overlay/WS_FILE/boot pin, 400 on missing workspace. Strictly sequential: all phases rewrite the same daemon.js seams and P3 depends on P2a's cache. Done when: no state.workspace/state.overlay refs remain in daemon.js/routes, missing-workspace ops re
